## Step-by-step Reasoning

Convert weight percent to moles (per 100 g of alloy):

$$n_{\mathrm{Ag}} = \frac{92.5}{107.87} = 0.8575 \text{ mol}, \qquad n_{\mathrm{Cu}} = \frac{7.5}{63.55} = 0.1180 \text{ mol}$$

Total moles:

$$n_{\text{tot}} = 0.8575 + 0.1180 = 0.9755 \text{ mol}$$

Atom percents:

$$C_{\mathrm{Ag}}' = \frac{0.8575}{0.9755}\times 100 \approx 87.90\text{ at\%}$$

$$C_{\mathrm{Cu}}' = \frac{0.1180}{0.9755}\times 100 \approx 12.10\text{ at\%}$$

$$\boxed{(87.90,\ 12.10)}$$
